create_weighted_moving_average_zeros_arr: create a WeightedMovingAverage initialized with a single zero array of given shape and dtype
create_weighted_moving_average_zeros_lik: create a WeightedMovingAverage with zeros matching the PyTree structure of a given value
update_weighted_moving_average: update a WeightedMovingAverage with a new value, old weight multiplier, and new weight using a custom add function
create_multi_chunk_accumulator_zeros_lik: create a MultiChunkAccumulator initialized with zeros matching the PyTree structure of a given object
add_to_multi_chunk_accumulator: add a weighted value object to a MultiChunkAccumulator and update its normalization weight
